name: ZAR Universal
oneLiner: ZARU is BlockTower's rand token, backed by cash and money-market funds with institutional redemption and retail partner access.
collateral: Rand bank deposits at Standard Bank and unit-trust money-market funds at Sanlam; the retrieved Moore report measures the August 31, 2026 Solana book, not current whole-token allocations.
pegMechanism: One ZAR per token through BlockTower's verified institutional mint/redemption service, subject to account and legal eligibility; retail access through network partners. The Platform User Agreement does not guarantee a redemption processing period. Issuer charges must be disclosed in advance; published terms give no complete numeric ceiling for issuer, bank and network fees.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos refinement Refine02 primary-source and RPC review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The whitepaper defines a fixed-rand, issuer-native liability backed by bank deposits and money-market instruments, not a variable-NAV fund share. Canonical Solana mint creation and initialization at slot 373091718 on 2025-10-13 establish pre-launch deployment history. The product launched for qualifying institutions on 2026-02-03; no later critical mechanism boundary is established, so no implementationLaunchDate override is authored.
